basic_info.description: Adorable light filled one bedroom unit exudes San Francisco charm. Elegant decorative accents throughout make this home special. Enjoy nights by the wood burning fireplace in the living area. An updated kitchen with abundant cabinets, stainless steel appliances and breakfast bar. A spacious bedroom overlooks the shared courtyard. Remodeled bathroom with storage vanity and marble floor tile. High ceilings, architectural details, and wood floors add character to this unit. Additional features include an in unit washer/dryer and dedicated storage space. This boutique building, with a well established HOA is a perfect pied-a-terre or first time home. This walker's paradise is well located in the Lower Nob Hill neighborhood near world class dining, galleries, theaters and Union Square.
